'''Tuff Bricks''' is a block from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds a [[Crafting Table]] recipe (from 2 × {{MCW|Tuff Brick Slab}}) and a [[Stonecutter]] recipe (from {{MCW|Tuff Brick Stairs}}). See {{MCW|Tuff Bricks}} for everything else.
